t.why: It hosts military bases of the United States, China, France, Japan and others all at once. It is Ethiopia's outlet to the sea.
t.rel: A small country at the mouth of the Red Sea that serves as landlocked Ethiopia's outlet to the sea, with a railway linking the two. It clashed with Eritrea over a border area in 2008. Its language and people are close to those of Somalia and Somaliland.
t.korea: Korea's Cheonghae naval unit has used it as a supply base for its Gulf of Aden operations.
t.know: Military bases of the United States, China, France, Japan and other countries are clustered in this one small country.
t.etext: At the chokepoint at the mouth of the Red Sea, it lives on ports and logistics. Most of Ethiopia's imports and exports pass through its port. Rent from foreign militaries' bases is also a big income.
